title: Phool Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Phool Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh, (2022) 2 SCC 74
content.holding: Affirmed that conviction for rape can be based on the sole testimony of the prosecutrix provided it is sterling, reliable, and consistent with the surrounding probabilities.
content.relevance: Reaffirms the modern standard for conviction on uncorroborated victim testimony.
